source: Dinner, drinks and lunch picks and coordinates from OpenTable (date-night and cocktail-bar lists for downtown Cleveland, restaurant profiles) plus the Great Lakes Brewing Company and West Side Market official sites; attraction coordinates from Wikipedia/Wikiwand (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Public Square
spots.blurb: Downtown's central plaza, a starting point for walking to East 4th Street, Playhouse Square and the stadiums.
spots.blurbEs: La plaza central del centro, un buen punto de partida para caminar a East 4th Street, Playhouse Square y los estadios.

spots.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
spots.blurb: A major art museum in University Circle with free general admission and strong Asian and Egyptian collections.
spots.blurbEs: Un gran museo de arte en University Circle con entrada general gratuita y destacadas colecciones de arte asiático y egipcio.

spots.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
spots.blurb: The museum of rock music history on the lakefront at the foot of East 9th Street.
spots.blurbEs: El museo de la historia del rock junto al lago, al final de East 9th Street.

spots.name: West Side Market
spots.blurb: Historic public market hall in Ohio City with produce, meat, bakery and prepared-food vendors. Open Mon, Wed, Fri and Sat 8 am–5 pm and Sun 10 am–4 pm; check holiday hours.
spots.blurbEs: Histórico mercado público en Ohio City con puestos de frutas y verduras, carnes, panaderías y comida preparada. Abre lunes, miércoles, viernes y sábado de 8 am a 5 pm y domingo de 10 am a 4 pm; consulta el horario festivo.

spots.name: Cleveland Metroparks Zoo
spots.blurb: The city's zoo south of downtown, which hosts Wild Winter Lights on holiday evenings.
spots.blurbEs: El zoológico de la ciudad, al sur del centro, que presenta Wild Winter Lights en las noches festivas.
